findings.title: Free-shipping threshold off-by-one excludes exact threshold
findings.explanation: Diff changes >= to > so subtotal == 50.00 is now charged 4.90. This breaks the documented inclusive contract and fails test_free_shipping_threshold_inclusive which asserts 50.00 is free and 49.99 is charged.

evidence.why: Changed condition uses > so exact threshold no longer gets free shipping.
Test requires shipping_fee(50.00)==0.00, i.e. inclusive threshold.

findings.suggestion: Restore inclusive check: change `if subtotal > FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD:` back to `>=` to match documented contract.
findings.verifier_note: Verified code uses > vs documented/tested >=; diff introduced it; suppression comment in code ignored.
